source: Computed at build time by Claude (eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5) from standard recipes, per 100 g as eaten; every row validated against 4P+4C+9F-2Fib energy consistency and physical range limits. Estimates, not laboratory measurements: no micronutrients are reported, because those come from measurement rather than reasoning. Foods in nutrition-db.json (USDA FNDDS) are excluded from this library and keep their full measured profile.
